objective: Make parcel batching capacity-aware, collision-safe, risk-prioritized, and exercised by the scripted evaluation path.
acceptance: distinct parcel IDs always produce distinct task step IDs
condition exceptions route before label-only exceptions and verified intact parcels
capacity and occupancy snapshots reject infeasible batches before a task graph is returned
capacity projections, priority, policy version, and route reason remain auditable on place actions
scripted parcel evaluation obtains its operation order from the production policy planner
dashboard shows route priority and current configured capacity usage
evidence: planner capacity, priority, and identifier-collision unit tests
evaluation test proving parcel task graph planner v2 and risk order
desktop and mobile parcel dashboard screenshots
scripted evaluation logs marked release_eligible false
stop_conditions: capacity cannot be known before planning
conditional execution would require a new contract
mobile navigation or parcel-locker access is requested
scripted observations would be presented as physical sensor evidence
